blocks.text: Yahan diye gaye do compounds dekhein: 1-hexene aur cyclohexane.

blocks.alt: 1-Hexene ka skeletal formula, chhe carbons ki tedhi zanjeer jis ke daen sire par double bond hai, 1-Hexene (C6H12); aur aik chhe-kona (hexagon), Cyclohexane (C6H12).
blocks.caption: 1-Hexene aur cyclohexane (29.1 ke shuru mein chhapi banawaton ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: In dono ka molecular formula aik hai (C₆H₁₂) lekin structure (banawat) alag hai, yani yeh isomers hain. In mein aik aur baat bhi milti hai: dono mein saturated alkane (hexane, C₆H₁₄) se do hydrogen atoms kam hain. Yani in mein do hydrogen atoms ki deficiency (kami) hai. Hydrogen ki yeh kami compound ki degree of unsaturation (unsaturation ka darja) batati hai. Index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD) isi unsaturation ka naap hai. Har do kam hydrogen atoms par compound mein aik degree of unsaturation hoti hai.
Isi liye oopar wale dono compounds ka IHD 1 hai.

blocks.title: Index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD)
blocks.text: Degree of unsaturation (U) ya IHD: compound aur usi tadaad ke carbon atoms wale acyclic (bina ring wale) alkane ke darmiyan hydrogen atoms ke pairs (joron) ki tadaad ka farq.

Har double bond ya ring saturated compound ke muqable do hydrogen atoms kam kar deta hai aur aik degree of unsaturation banata hai. Maslan C₄H₆ mein saturated C₄H₁₀ se chaar hydrogen atoms kam hain, is liye is ki do degrees of unsaturation hain (IHD = 2).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Hydrocarbon CₓHᵧ ke liye seedha formula: IHD = (2x + 2 − y) / 2. Maslan C₄H₆: (2 × 4 + 2 − 6) / 2 = 4 / 2 = 2.

IHD maloom ho to molecule ki banawat ke bare mein ishare (clues) mil jate hain. Maslan agar IHD 0 ho to yaqeeni hai ke compound mein na koi ring hai na koi double bond. Yeh bohat kaam ki baat hai, kyun ke yeh number sirf chemical formula dekh kar asaani se nikal aata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Double bond aur ring dono aik aik IHD gine jate hain. Triple bond do IHD gina jata hai.

Agar IHD 1 ho to compound mein ya aik ring hai ya aik double bond, dono nahi ho sakte. Agar IHD 2 ho to kai soorten hain: do rings, do double bonds, aik ring aur aik double bond, ya aik triple bond. Is tarah mushkil analytical techniques (tajziye ke tareeqon) ke baghair bhi IHD bohat maloomat deta hai. Kisi technique ko use karne se pehle IHD yeh faisla karne mein bhi madad deta hai ke is compound ke liye kaun si technique behtar hogi. Hydrocarbons ka IHD Table 29.1 ki madad se nikala ja sakta hai.

blocks.caption: Table 29.1 Index of hydrogen deficiency
rows: 2 double bonds ya 2 rings ya 1 double bond aur 1 ring ya 1 triple bond

blocks.prompt: a) In ka IHD nikalein: i) C₆H₆ ii) C₆H₁₂ iii) C₄H₄. b) In ka structure tajweez karein (batayein).
blocks.explanation: i) C₆H₆: (2 × 6 + 2 − 6) / 2 = 4, maslan benzene (aik ring + teen C=C). ii) C₆H₁₂: (14 − 12) / 2 = 1, maslan hex-1-ene ya cyclohexane. iii) C₄H₄: (10 − 4) / 2 = 3, maslan but-1-en-3-yne, CH₂=CH–C≡CH (aik C=C + aik triple bond).

blocks.prompt: c) Hopane ka formula C₃₀H₅₂ hai (kitab mein C₃₀H₆₂ chhapa hai). i) Is ka IHD nikalein. ii) Kya yeh saturated hai?
blocks.explanation: C₃₀H₅₂: (2 × 30 + 2 − 52) / 2 = 5. Hopane mein paanch rings hain aur koi double bond nahi, is liye yeh saturated hai. (Kitab ke formula C₃₀H₆₂ se IHD 0 aata hai: woh bhi saturated, lekin bina ring ke.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab hopane ka formula C₃₀H₆₂ likhti hai. Asal mein hopanes paanch rings wale saturated hydrocarbons hain jin ka formula C₃₀H₅₂ hai (IHD = 5). C₃₀H₆₂ to bina ring wale alkane ka formula hai (IHD = 0).

items: IHD = alkane CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ ke muqable kam hydrogen atoms ke pairs.
Har ring ya double bond = 1; triple bond = 2.
IHD 0: na ring na double bond.
